verdict.rationale: Mintlify's automations feature explicitly supports running the agent 'on a schedule, on repository pushes, or on connected integration events,' which is direct evidence of recurring scheduled jobs — but scoped specifically to documentation-maintenance workflows rather than general-purpose job scheduling. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the scheduling feature working, details on schedule granularity/configuration, and evidence of broader workflow orchestration beyond doc-agent tasks.
